name: ClinGen (dosage sensitivity, gene-disease validity, region curation)

version.value: Files regenerated daily (gene curation list dated 2026-10-25); recurrent CNV V2.1 since 2026-03-18

scope: Haploinsufficiency and triplosensitivity scores for genes and genomic regions, recurrent CNV regions (V2.1), and curated gene-disease validity.
identifiers: HGNC symbol and NCBI Gene ID
mapping_methods: Gene- and region-level; coordinates given for GRCh37 and GRCh38.

quantitative.summary: Categorical dosage scores (0-3, 30, 40) and validity classifications.

licence.name: ClinGen terms: curated content released openly, free to capture and use

coverage_limitations: Only genes and regions that have been through curation
known_omissions: Variant-level classifications are in ClinVar / ClinGen Allele Registry, not in these files

reuse_decision.rationale: Small, openly licensed and directly addresses dosage sensitivity and CNV interpretation; Open Targets carries only evidence_clingen gene-disease links.
